name: Cero Sahade
source:
Student of the History faculty of Moosgrun university. Best friend and love interest of [url=/c3737]Wakaba[/url], same as  [url=/c3732]Coco[/url]'s caretaker. Cero took the passion for history from his deceased father. 

Always patient and polite he still could be quite stubborn and bold than necessary.
